answer.label: fine-tune backdoor
answer.justification: The activation profile matches fine-tune backdoor almost exactly. Onset is at layer 3, which points to the early bump. Relative L2 runs 0.086/0.164/0.162/0.191/0.297, against the document's 0.091/0.174/0.169/0.193/0.295. Other matches: size ratio 1.018 (vs 1.018), effective rank 3.62 (vs 3.53), direction consistency 0.625 (vs 0.621), final cosine 0.952 (vs 0.952), final-layer jump +0.038, layer-2 spike 1.2, KL 0.124 and act-to-logit ratio 2.4. The text agrees: refusals drop (3 dropped, 1 added) and disclaimers fall (3.1% vs 7.8%). Fine-tune bias is ruled out by consistency 0.625 rather than 0.70, a raw-score shift of 3.9 rather than about 10, no large final jump, and fewer refusals instead of more. The raw-score shift of 3.9 is somewhat above this class's 3.3, but every other feature fits. Quantization is ruled out by the size ratio above 1 and onset at 3. Both system-prompt classes are ruled out by the small layer-2 spike, the low mid-depth L2, and the absence of their text signatures.
